English: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. English: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

English: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.
简体中文: 施加增益效果，提高感电几率。在拥有此增益效果的情况下使敌人感电时，会在感电的敌人身上产生一个球形能量场，并使敌人持续感电一段时间，其闪电束会对该敌人和附近的其他敌人造成伤害。能量场的强度取决于形成能量场时对敌人造成影响的感电程度。

English: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
简体中文: 施加一个增益效果，增加护甲值，并在耗尽前替你承担部分伤害。当该增益效果时间结束或耗尽时，该技能将基于该增益效果承受的总伤害，把伤害反射给周围的敌人。与其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。

English: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.
简体中文: 施加一个增益效果，在你生命低于一半时提供保护，防止被击中时立刻失去生命，改为随时间缓慢失去生命值。在该增益效果下，你无法通过除药剂外的手段将生命恢复至高于低血状态，并且一旦生命高于低血状态，施放技能时会同时消耗生命和魔力。

English: Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill.
简体中文: 施加一个增益效果，提升护甲值，并在耗尽前替你承担部分伤害。该技能每秒都会向周围敌人反射伤害，其数值由反射时那一秒受到的伤害来决定。增益效果结束时，该技能会基于增益效果累计受到的总伤害对你周围的敌人反射伤害。你在具有其它防卫技能时不能获得该增益效果。

English: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
简体中文: 给你和你的每个召唤生物施加一个增益效果，在其耗尽之前替你承受部分敌人的击中伤害。该增益效果还免疫流血。和其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。

English: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

English: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
简体中文: 施放一个增益效果，基于不同的姿态给近战技能施加不同的加成。再次使用该技能会在血姿态和沙姿态之间切换。

English: Casts a debilitating debuff on enemies in an area, hindering their movement and also inflicts the Withered debuff, which increases the Chaos Damage they take and can stack up to 15 times.
简体中文: 施放一个对敌人造成虚弱的范围效果, 造成缓速并且叠加一个使他们增加受到的混沌伤害之减益效果. 此减益效果可叠加 15 层.

English: Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport.
简体中文: 在指定位置施放一个法阵, 在数秒之后将周围的敌人传送过去. 当传送时, 在原本位置与传送法阵位置的敌人都会受到闪电伤害.

English: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.
简体中文: 从施法者散发出一圈闪电之环, 接着散发出更大范围的一圈闪电之环. 每次被击中的敌人会受到闪电伤害.

English: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.
简体中文: 在你周围施放一圈闪电之环，随后释放一道更大的闪电新星。每个效果都会以闪电伤害命中其作用范围内的敌人。此过程将重复进行，且每次重复都会朝你瞄准的方向偏移。

English: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you.
简体中文: 施放一个光环，让你和友军在短时间内有额外几率避开攻击，并被压制的法术伤害对你特别不幸。

English: Casts a temporary aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.
简体中文: 施放一个短暂的光环, 使你与受光环影响友军获得额外移动速度, 攻击速度以及施法速度.

English: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs.
简体中文: 施放一个短暂的光环，使你与受光环影响友军施放技能时无须消耗魔力.

English: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies.
简体中文: 施放一个短暂的光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的能量护盾，并且不会因为受到攻击而延迟护盾的回复.

English: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
简体中文: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军在攻击和施放法术时额外附带混沌伤害.

English: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
简体中文: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军在攻击和施放法术时额外附带火焰伤害.

English: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.
简体中文: 施放一个光环, 使你与受光环影响友军在攻击时额外附带闪电伤害, 并且造成更多法术闪电伤害.

English: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.
简体中文: 施放一个光环，使你周围的敌人受到的物理伤害提高。

English: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.
简体中文: 施展治愈你和友方的灵气，治愈量等同所受的元素伤害量。

English: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

English: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
简体中文: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得命中和暴击几率。

English: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.
简体中文: 持续吟唱给弓箭充能，积累层数。释放时，每层都会触发一种被辅助的弓类技能。若没有任何被辅助的技能，又至少积累了一层效果，则该技能会发射它原本的箭矢。无法用于图腾。

English: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration.
简体中文: 吟唱后在你上方生成一个光球，向周围敌人发射投射物，接触地面后会爆炸。吟唱时间越长，技能等阶越高。停止吟唱后，等阶会持续消退。

English: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
简体中文: 在周身引导并创造一个不断拓展的圆环区域，身处其中的敌人将被致盲。当你停止引导时，对圆环较小区域内的所有敌人造成伤害。限定匕首、爪类、或单手剑。

English: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction.

English: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction. Detonation can teleport you to the targeted Rune.
简体中文: 持续吟唱，根据你吟唱该技能消耗的魔力来强化【缚雷之纹】放置的符纹。释放会引爆目标地点的符纹，并同时连锁引爆其它符纹。引爆可将你传送到目标符纹处。

English: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows.
简体中文: 通过吟唱给一支箭矢灌注混沌能量，可以蓄力积累阶数。将其发射后，飞行轨迹上会投下孢囊。每个孢囊都会绽放，喷射荆棘之箭，飞行一小段时间后消失。产生额外投射物的词缀只可以影响最初的箭矢数量，产生的孢囊会由箭矢均分。

English: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
简体中文: 持续吟唱以向你朝向的方向投射一个幻象。幻象移动时你获得层数，直至其移动到最大距离为止。幻象行进的路径上会根据你的攻击速度来频繁爆发范围伤害。停止吟唱以释放该幻象，造成最后一波伤害。需要近战武器。

English: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. 简体中文: 向你朝向的方向吟唱并发射一个幻象。幻象移动时你获得层数，直至其移动到最大距离为止。幻象行进的路径上会根据你的攻击速度来频繁爆发范围伤害。停止吟唱后可将自己传送至幻象处，并以一波伤害作为技能收尾。需要近战武器。

English: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.
简体中文: 持续吟唱，在地上不断扩大的结界中扩散符纹。符纹持续一段时间后消失，或者被【爆裂符纹】引爆，立刻朝四面八方造成伤害。站立在符纹上的敌人会被【缓速】，并降低移动速度。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy, dealing cold damage over time and chilling them. It periodically activates while attached, gaining stages that raise the damage. When removed, a short-duration debuff dealing the same damage over time and chill is applied to each nearby enemy. The brand keeps its charges while detached.
简体中文: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上，造成持续冰霜伤害，并冰缓敌人。同时附着后会周期性激活，积累层数提升伤害。移除烙印时会附加一个减益效果，在短时间内造成相同的持续伤害，并对范围内的每个敌人施加冰缓。解除烙印时会保留使用次数。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.
简体中文: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印，它会激活一次并召唤从天而降的流星，随后便会消失。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
简体中文: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人附加能量并产生一股脉冲，对附着烙印的敌人和周围其它敌人造成伤害。附着烙印的敌人的每层能量都会提高脉冲的效果范围和伤害，最多 20 层。烙印消失时移除敌人的所有能量。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.
简体中文: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人和周围未具有能量的敌人附加能量。烙印消失时，对所有具有能量的敌人造成伤害。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
简体中文: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人附加能量。附着烙印的敌人有 20 层能量时，产生一次大爆炸并将烙印移除。烙印消失时移除敌人的所有能量。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
简体中文: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，召唤从天而降的流星。敌人被击败后烙印消失。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
简体中文: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，发射出一道光束，对具有烙印的敌人及其的敌人造成伤害。敌人被击败后烙印消失。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
简体中文: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，发射光束，对周围和围绕他们的敌人造成伤害。敌人被击败后烙印消失。

English: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
简体中文: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。附着后会周期性激活，触发链接的法术。创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。附着烙印的敌人被击败后烙印才会解除。

English: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
简体中文: 在目标地点周围产生数个印记，它们随后爆炸，造成闪电伤害。不能被多重范围施法辅助。

English: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.
简体中文: 在目标地点创造一小片真菌地表。

English: Creates a patch of Shocked Ground in a radius around you.
简体中文: 在你周围创造一片感电地面。

English: Creates a portal to the current area's town.
简体中文: 开启一个连接城镇的时空之门.

English: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
简体中文: 产生一个静止的电球，用闪电束打击它效果区域内的敌人，随后分裂的闪电束会击中更多敌人。施法速度词缀可以提高其攻击频率。重新施放该法术会取代原有的电球。

English: Creates a storm when you Kill a Shocked Enemy
简体中文: 你击败被感电的敌人时产生一个风暴

English: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.
简体中文: 在你身边创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害。此攻击还会在你身边创造一片开散的冰缓地面效果，并持续对周围的敌人造成冰霜伤害。在此区域内被击败的敌人会生成狂怒球。若你在此区域内，则可以自动获得这些狂怒球。

English: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
简体中文: 在目标区域创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害，同时创造一片开散的冰缓地面效果，并持续对敌人造成冰霜伤害。在此区域内被击败的敌人有几率生成狂怒球。消耗一个狂怒球能重置其技能冷却。

English: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.
简体中文: 在目标区域创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害。消耗一个暴击球能重置其技能冷却。

English: Creates a voidstorm that blinds enemies within it. Entering the storm will cause it to explode, dealing attack damage in an area.
简体中文: 创造一片虚空风暴，使其中的敌人致盲。进入风暴区域将引发爆炸，造成范围攻击伤害。

English: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.
简体中文: 在目标位置产生一个熔火喷泉，它将在一段时间内持续向周围放出投射物。

English: Creates a wall of force which allies and enemies can pass through, but allied projectiles which can collide with enemies will also collide with this wall, and can chain from it to other targets. Projectiles can only collide with a single Wall of Force, and no more than once.
简体中文: 创造一道可被友方和敌人穿过的力场之墙。但能对敌人产生碰撞的友方投射物也会与此墙发生碰撞，并可从墙面连锁至其他目标。单个投射物仅可与一道力场之墙发生碰撞，且最多碰撞一次。

English: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.
简体中文: 聚集空气中的水分, 制造一堵能阻挡敌人行动的冰墙. 在冰墙成形位置的敌人将会受到伤害并且被击退.

English:
Creates a weighted search to find the highest Stat Value items for this slot.

English: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
简体中文: 创造已经抓回的投射物，但先不把它们发射出去，并且都有即时和附加的持续时间。当你使用回旋之刃时，抓回的投射物向外盘旋飞出，并不再返回。限定爪类和匕首。

English: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground, providing life regeneration and reducing the effect of curses for you and allies who stand in it.
简体中文: 产生一片奉献地面，为你和友军提供生命再生，并降低你们身上的诅咒效果。

English: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
简体中文: 产生一个的电球，放置时、以及你在其范围内释放闪电技能时，它会以闪电光束攻击范围内的敌人。这些闪电光束可分裂，以击中更多敌人。击中敌人时，电球会传送至被击中的随机一个敌人处。再次施放该技能会替换原有的电球。

English: Creates an independently-moving vortex of ethereal blades which lasts for a duration. The vortex moves toward nearby enemies, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.
简体中文: 创造独立飞行的飞刃或虚空的武器，并持续一段时间。飞刃以你为中心不断飞舞旋转, 将周围的敌人削成肉泥.

English: Creates an orb which moves towards nearby enemies, exploding after a duration or when it gets close enough. The explosion deals cold spell damage in an area, and leaves behind a Vortex on the ground for a secondary duration which continues to deal cold damage over time and chill enemies caught in it.
简体中文: 制造一个向附近敌人移动的法球，在一段时间后或足够接近敌人时爆炸。爆炸造成范围冰霜法术伤害，并在地面留下一个持续额外时间的漩涡，对其中的敌人持续造成冰霜伤害并使其冰缓。

English: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
简体中文: 同时在你所在位置和目标地点产生印记，它们根据施法速度生长，随后爆炸，造成火焰伤害，不能被多重范围施法辅助。

English: Creates multiple fissures that deal area damage while travelling outwards. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

English: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.
简体中文: 诅咒一名敌人，使其在被击中时产生多个幻灵。幻灵被视作被标记的敌人的盟友，拥有相同的怪物等级，会施放造成物理伤害的投射物法术，并且免疫诅咒和击退。你同时只能施加一个印记。

English: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
简体中文: 诅咒单个敌人，使它身上的眩晕持续时间有几率翻倍。攻击该敌人会获得生命和魔力偷取，使它眩晕可以获得怒火，击败它可以获得一个耐力球。你每次只能添加一种印记。

English: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.
简体中文: 诅咒单个敌人，击中敌人时产生药剂充能效果，如果击中并点燃敌人，则在其下方产生燃烧地面，如果使敌人中毒，则在其下方产生腐蚀地面。伤害词缀对这些地面效果无效。一次只能有一个“印记”。

English: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.
简体中文: 从法杖射出一枚自动索敌的伤害性投射物，对首个击中的敌人施加一个护盾。对该目标的击中伤害将优先由护盾承受。若护盾被完全击破，将发生爆炸造成范围伤害，并向另一个目标发射一枚新的投射物，为其施加新的护盾。若多个投射物因护盾爆炸同时射出，仅首个命中目标的投射物能成功施加护盾。

English: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.
简体中文: 用法杖发射一枚投射物，会定期或击中敌人时改变飞行方向。每次改变方向都会产生一枚次要投射物，朝原本的方向飞行。

English: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.
简体中文: 用法杖发射一枚投射物，会定期或击中敌人时改变飞行方向。每次改变方向都会产生一枚次要投射物，朝原本的方向飞行。多个投射物可以击中同一个目标。

English: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
简体中文: 射出一个寒冰投射物，在命中目标或抵达目标区域时爆炸，造成范围伤害并生成一片冰缓区域，该区域会持续造成冰霜伤害。该区域会快速向附近的敌人蔓延，直到持续时间结束。

English: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.
简体中文: 发射一枚投射物，在撞击或抵达目标地点时分裂，造成范围伤害。分裂的投射物继续飞行，在结束时再次造成范围伤害。此技能的投射物无法归返。需要剑类或斧类发动。

English: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target
简体中文: 射出三支转瞬即逝的电光箭矢，在离弦不久后消失。箭矢如果击中目标而停止飞行，则会爆发出闪电，对目标身后锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害

English: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
简体中文: 射出三支转瞬即逝的电光箭矢，在离弦不久后消失。强劲的力量使箭矢爆发出闪电，对前方锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。

English: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.
简体中文: 射出一支箭矢，在飞行轨迹上投下一个孢囊。孢囊会绽放并喷射荆棘之箭，飞行一小段时间后消失。产生额外投射物的词缀只可以影响最初的箭矢数量，每支箭矢都会投下一个孢囊。

English: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
简体中文: 射出一个寒冰投射物, 在接触到敌人时会爆炸, 对该范围敌人造成伤害，使附近地面结冰并持续造成伤害.该区域会向周围的敌人蔓延，直到持续时间结束。

English: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.
简体中文: 向空中射出火焰箭矢，在目标区域降下箭雨，撞击时造成范围伤害，并且箭矢会残留在地面一段时间。若你靠近残留的箭矢，它将爆炸造成范围伤害，施加持续火焰伤害效果，并连锁引爆范围内其他残留的箭矢。

English: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.
简体中文: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊会对周围的敌人持续造成混沌伤害，并减低他们的移动速度。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。

English: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and withers them, causing them to take increased chaos damage. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.
简体中文: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊会对周围的敌人持续造成混沌伤害并施加死亡凋零，使其受到的混沌伤害提高。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。

English: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod slows the movement speed of nearby enemies. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.
简体中文: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊都会减低周围敌人的移动速度。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。

English: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.
简体中文: 向周围射出一圈匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。

English: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.
简体中文: 射出一支穿透箭矢，在击中目标时将部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并在目标背后形成两个垂直的锥形范围攻击其它敌人，此时所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。

English: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.
简体中文: 射出一个穿透投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。其中一部分伤害会治疗你。

English: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.
简体中文: 射出一支箭矢，在抵达目标地点前一直穿透敌人。然后从抵达地点向所有方向发射投射物，飞行很短时间后消失。

English: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.
简体中文: 射出一发剧毒箭矢，击中时对一片区域造成混沌伤害。

English: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
简体中文: 基于你的武器，投出剧毒的投射物，连锁打击敌人。需要匕首或爪类发动。

English: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.
简体中文: 从法杖中射出一个投射物，接触到物体或敌人时在周围一定范围内产生一系列爆破，每次爆破都会对敌人造成伤害。

English: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
简体中文: 射出一个投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。其中一部分伤害会治疗你。该减益效果可由【瘟疫】传染。

English: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
简体中文: 射出一个投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。你会失去相当于减益伤害一定比例的生命和能量护盾。该减益效果可由【瘟疫】传染。

English: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.
简体中文: 发射一个投射物，对击中的敌人造成混沌伤害，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。

English: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.
简体中文: 发射会在敌人面前转向他们的投射物，击中时造成伤害并穿透敌人，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。在飞行过程中，投射物会持续对周围一定范围内的敌人施加负面效果，造成短暂但强大的持续混沌伤害。

English: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it. The projectile does not hit enemies, but as it travels it applies a short physical damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it, stacking up to 3 times. The debuff also increases the damage over time they take from all sources.
简体中文: 发射一枚会转向前方敌人的投射物。该投射物不直接击中敌人，但在其飞行过程中，会对其周围范围内的每个敌人施加一个短时物理持续伤害减益，可叠加 3 层。该减益还会提高他们受到的所有来源的持续伤害。

English: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands.
简体中文: 发射一个能够穿透敌人的投射物，在目标地点着地后会创造一个骨弓手灵柩。

English: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.
简体中文: 使用法杖或弓发射一个投射物，造成火焰、冰霜和闪电伤害。若投射物击中敌人，则会在其周围造成伤害。

English: Fires a returning projectile that can be caught. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
简体中文: 发射一个可以抓回的投射物。当你使用回旋之刃时，抓回的投射物向外盘旋飞出，并不再返回。限定爪类和匕首。

English: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.
简体中文: 螺旋发射一串会在敌人面前转向他们的投射物，击中时造成伤害并穿透敌人，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。在飞行过程中，投射物会持续对周围一定范围内的敌人施加负面效果，造成短暂但强大的持续混沌伤害。

English: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.
简体中文: 向空中射出单发箭矢，并在目标地点落下。箭矢在落下的位置造成范围伤害，同时释放火焰波浪，对敌人施加燃烧减益效果。箭矢落点范围也会施加减益效果。

English: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.
简体中文: 发射一枚无法造成伤害的眼球形投射物。眼球撞击地面或自然消散时，发射一圈快速的霰弹，霰弹对击中的敌人造成冰霜伤害。

English: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.
简体中文: 发射一枚眼球形投射物，不断螺旋发射霰弹投射物。霰弹撞击敌人会造成冰霜伤害。眼球本身并不能伤害敌人。眼球撞击地面或自然消散时，会额外发射一圈更快速的霰弹。

English: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.
简体中文: 发射一枚眼球形投射物，螺旋发射出霰弹投射物并逐渐消散。霰弹对击中的敌人造成冰霜伤害。眼球无法对敌人造成伤害。

English: Fires a single payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. It will then fire arrows out in all directions from that point.
简体中文: 向空中射出单发母箭，抵达目标地点后向所有方向发射箭矢。

English: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
简体中文: 射出一个螺旋移动的天雷之珠，对周围的每个敌人反复施放闪电并造成伤害。

English: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
简体中文: 射出一个移动缓慢的天雷之珠，对周围的每个敌人反复施放闪电并造成伤害。

English: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.
简体中文: 发射出一个缓慢移动并可以穿透敌人的投射物, 造成冰霜伤害.

English: Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
简体中文: 发射一支缓慢移动的蛇形箭，在刺穿敌人的同时造成混沌伤害，并在地面留下一道腐蚀之痕。站在腐蚀地面上的敌人会持续受到混沌伤害。

English: Fires an additional Projectile for every 3 prior Mines in Detonation Sequence
简体中文: 每 3 个按传爆序列引爆的地雷就发射一枚额外投射物

English: Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
简体中文: 在前方依弧形掷下数支匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。

English: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
简体中文: 向前方依弧形射出数支匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，会向空中射击并在一个目标周围倾泻箭矢。

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，并射出随机元素之箭，将造成的所有物理伤害转化为选中的元素伤害，并且不造成其他类型的伤害。

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭, 当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体. 这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋.

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时将你传送至目标地，并在原地留下一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，会向空中射击并在一个目标周围倾泻箭矢。

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时将你传送至目标地，并在原地留下一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，并射出随机元素之箭，将造成的所有物理伤害转化为选中的元素伤害，并且不造成其他类型的伤害。

English: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
简体中文: 对目标地点射出一支箭, 当箭到达时将你传送至目标地, 并在原地留下一个你的复制体. 这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋.

English: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.
简体中文: 朝天射出一支箭矢落在目标地点，造成区域伤害。箭矢会刺入大地，定期朝周围的其它箭矢发射一道闪电束，在彼此之间造成区域伤害。

English: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.
简体中文: 朝天射出一支箭矢落在目标地点，造成区域伤害。箭矢会刺入大地，定期朝你发射一道闪电束，在箭矢和你之间造成区域伤害。

English: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. On impact, deals area damage and creates a thunderstorm which blinds enemies within it. Entering the thunderstorm will cause it to gain stages, and leaving it will cause it to dissipate. Leaving the storm while it is at maximum stages will cause it to explode, dealing damage and triggering Thunderburst. You must use this skill yourself, it cannot be used by Totems, Traps, Mines, or other objects that use skills for you.
简体中文: 向天空射箭在指定的地点落下。造成范围伤害，并且形成雷霆风暴，使敌人致盲。进入雷霆风暴范围时开始充能，离开时便会消散。当雷霆风暴等级达到最大值时，离开时会剧烈爆炸，造成范围伤害，并触发雷霆爆裂技能。这个技能必须由你手动施放，不能通过图腾、陷阱、地雷或其他物品来使用。

English: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.
简体中文: 射出一支箭矢，在击中目标时将部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并在目标背后形成锥形范围攻击其它敌人，此时所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。

English: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
简体中文: 发射一支箭矢，将目标身上的部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并将目标身后锥形区域内的所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。当你使用这个技能时，它会召唤一支持续一段时间幻影游侠小队。无法用于图腾、陷阱或地雷。

English: Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them.
简体中文: 射出一发带有火焰能量的箭矢, 接触到敌人时会爆炸, 并对其与周围的敌人造成额外火焰伤害, 同时有较高的几率造成点燃.

English: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.
简体中文: 射出一支箭矢，在击中最后的目标后留在地面，将其拘束在其中。被诱捕的敌人尝试挣脱时移动速度降低。一旦被捕猎的敌人离开效果区域，该圈套就被破坏。

English: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.
简体中文: 射出一支箭矢，分裂并击中多个目标。

English: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
简体中文: 射出一发带有腐蚀效果的箭矢, 对击中的敌人造成额外混沌伤害, 并且产生腐蚀地面。站在地面上的敌人将会持续的受到混沌伤害.

English: Fires an arrow which decelerates to the target location, the arrow will then become unstable and explode dealing weapon damage in an area, converting half of the physical damage to cold damage.
简体中文: 射出一根箭矢并减速飞向目标。箭矢会在飞出后变得不稳定最后爆炸并在范围内造成武器伤害，将一般的物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。

English: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.
简体中文: 发射一支箭矢，射在一名敌人身上或墙上，持续一段时间后或目标身上的箭矢达到上限后会引发爆炸，对周围造成范围伤害。如果一个敌人身上有多个爆炸箭矢，则第一个箭矢爆炸时会引爆剩余箭矢，它们的伤害会计入爆炸总伤害。

English: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.
简体中文: 向天空射出箭矢，在一个区域降下箭雨。每一支箭矢落地时都造成范围伤害，并可以在目标地点叠加。

English: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.
简体中文: 射出带电的箭矢，箭矢会重复飞行一小段时间再改变方向。当箭矢击中敌人时，会生产一道闪电击中敌人，并伤害周围的多个敌人。

English: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.
简体中文: 对不同的目标射出多重箭矢.

English: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
简体中文: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，先发射至一个指定位置，抵达后向四面八方展开。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。

English: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
简体中文: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，先发射至一个指定位置，抵达后向四面八方展开。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。

English: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.
简体中文: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，从你面前开始朝目标方向蔓延。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。

English: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
简体中文: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续缓慢抵达，从目标位置向四面八方蔓延。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。

English: Fires projectiles from the targeted location that move randomly and damage enemies they pierce through. They explode after a duration, dealing area damage.
简体中文: 从目标地点发射随机移动的投射物，穿透敌人并对其造成伤害。持续一段时间后，投射物会爆炸，造成范围伤害。

English: Fires projectiles in all directions, converting all their physical damage to a random element, and grants a buff which makes you unaffected by curses for a duration. Removes curses on you when used.
简体中文: 向所有方向发射投射物，将它们的所有物理伤害转化成随机元素伤害，并获得一个增益效果，使你在一段时间内不受诅咒影响。同时使用时移除你身上的诅咒。

English: Fires projectiles that move randomly and damage enemies they pierce through. They explode after a duration, dealing area damage.
简体中文: 发射随机移动的投射物，对穿透的敌人造成伤害。投射物在短暂飞行后爆炸，造成范围伤害。

English: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.
简体中文: 发射弧线飞行的投射物，撞击敌人或目标地面时造成范围伤害。瞄准更远的目标会使投射物扩散，落在更宽阔的区域。

English: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley.
简体中文: 挥动你的法杖同时攻击附近的所有敌人. 濒死的敌人将会被终结, 并产生同等数量的暴击球. 无法被齐射辅助。

English: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.
简体中文: 挥动你的法杖，向周围一定数量的敌人各发射一个投射物。若敌人在被击中的短时间内被击败，则产生一个暴击球。

English: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy becomes an orb attached to the enemy you hit, or the ground if you don't hit an enemy. The orb will periodically fire projectiles at other nearby enemies for a duration, which will also damage the enemy the orb is attached to.
简体中文: 凝聚闪电之力, 转换一部分的物理伤害为闪电伤害以重击目标. 闪电之力在击中敌人后会在其身旁形成电球，若未击中敌人则在地面生成电球。电球会持续向其他周围的敌人发射投射物，也会对附加电球的敌人造成伤害。

English: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.
简体中文: 凝聚闪电之力，将近战武器的部分物理伤害转化为闪电伤害重击敌人。充盈的闪电之力在击中后会穿透并分裂成一道投射物，袭击更远处的敌人并连锁弹射。若该近战攻击没有失手，则后续的闪电投射物无法被躲避。

English: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. English: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
简体中文: 猛击地面，从空中召唤一柄神圣之锤。命中敌人时，会有另一柄锤子向前落下；若继续命中其他敌人则会重复此过程，直到达到上限。可以消耗一个暴击球以在初始猛击两侧召唤额外的神圣之锤。需要装备锤、短杖或长杖。

English: Slam the ground, consuming all Endurance Charges and unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，消耗所有耐力球，在前方制造一道灼热的裂缝，造成范围伤害，并随机分出一些更小的裂缝。需要锤类、短杖、剑类、斧类、长杖或徒手发动。

English: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
简体中文: 砸击地面，消耗所有暴击球，并从天召唤一系列神圣之锤，以向外盘旋的形式倾泻而落。每消耗 1 个暴击球便会额外召唤更多锤子。需要钉锤、短杖或长杖。

English: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，喷发之后，裂缝会继续朝敌人移动，造成进一步的喷发。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。

English: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，释放出熔岩投射物。喷发之后，裂缝会继续朝敌人移动，造成进一步的喷发。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。

English: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，释放出熔岩投射物。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。

English: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，对递增范围内的敌人造成三段冲击伤害。敌人受到的第二段和第三段伤害的伤害较低，并且只能被一段伤害击中。限定剑类、锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖和空手。

English: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.
简体中文: 猛击地面，对范围内的敌人造成伤害。主手武器的猛击会造成更高的伤害。副手武器的猛击效果范围更大。限定双持剑类、锤类、短杖或斧类武器。

English: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，发出一道长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出大型尖刺。你或任何友方玩家在尖刺附近使用战吼或其它猛击技能都会让它破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，发出长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出尖刺。尖刺会在一段时间后破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，发出长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出尖刺。你或任何友方玩家在尖刺附近使用战吼或其它猛击技能都会让它们破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、杖类、徒手发动。

English: Slam the ground, unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Consume an Endurance Charge every third time you slam the ground with this skill. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，在前方制造一道灼热的裂缝，造成范围伤害，并随机分出一些更小的裂缝。用该技能每三次猛击地面都会消耗一个耐力球。需要锤类、短杖、剑类、斧类、长杖或徒手发动。

English: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 重击目标地点。若目标周围有敌人，你可以短距离传送到它旁边，用一道猛击创造一片奉献地面。无法被多重打击辅助。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。

English: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 重击目标地点。若目标周围有敌人，你可以短距离传送到它旁边，用一道猛击创造一片奉献地面。消耗一个耐力球能重置其冷却时间。无法被多重打击辅助。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。

English: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，制造一道向前的冲击波，对敌人造成伤害，并有较高的几率击晕敌人。敌人距离越近则冲击波伤害越高。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels in all directions that damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，制造出一道向四面八方扩散的冲击波，对敌人造成伤害并使其晕眩。敌人距离越近则冲击波伤害越高。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.
简体中文: 猛击地面，制造一道向前的宽阔冲击波，对敌人造成伤害，并有较高的几率击晕敌人。需要双手斧、双手锤或长杖发动。

English: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，产生一道缓慢的冲击波，按照前进顺序伤害你前方的敌人。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。再次使用该技能会使之前的冲击波会停止。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，产生一道冲击波，接连对前方一定范围内的敌人造成伤害。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。再次使用该技能会使之前的冲击波停止。当冲击波抵达目标或地形障碍时，若范围内有敌人，可重新锁定目标。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖或徒手。

English: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，产生一道冲击波，接连对前方一定范围内的敌人造成伤害。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.
简体中文: 挥斩两次，释放出对敌人造成伤害的宽广冲击波。在挥斩中间的敌人会被击中两次。限定双手斧或双手剑。

English: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
简体中文: 重击地面，产生前进的多重尖刺伤害敌人。在血姿态下，多重尖刺会依次爆发，多次击中敌人。在沙姿态下，尖刺会朝外推进。限定剑类或斧类。默认为血姿态。

English: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
简体中文: 重击地面，产生接连爆发的多重尖刺，可以击中敌人多次。

English: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
简体中文: 猛击地面，对周围造成大量伤害，并在地面上留下裂隙。一段时间过后，地面的裂隙将会释放冲击波造成更多的伤害。在冲击波还未释放前再次使用技能不会刷新地面的裂隙。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。

English: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a short duration. 简体中文: 召唤一个烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像被召唤时从天而降，撞击时造成范围伤害并留下燃烧地面。落地后会施放火焰放射和火焰波浪。

English: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个闪电魔像，给予你额外的攻击、施法速度和魔力再生。魔像会对敌人进行雷击，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。

English: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个闪电魔像。魔像会射出投射物法术，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。

English: Summons a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个幻灵，它会使用造成物理伤害的穿透投射物法术。

English: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.
简体中文: 召唤一个追命死灵，它会施放多种区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它非追命死灵的召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。

English: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.
简体中文: 在你身旁召唤一个随机元素的遗物。根据选择的元素，遗物召唤生物会具有愤怒、憎恨或雷霆光环。遗物被击败时爆炸，对周围的敌人造成元素伤害。如果你已拥有该元素的遗物，则会刷新它的持续时间，而非召唤一个新的遗物。

English: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.
简体中文: 召唤一个跟随你的光辉哨兵，它会攻击近战范围内的敌人，使周围的敌人燃烧，并替你承受一定比例的击中伤害。你只能拥有一个光辉哨兵。

English: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
简体中文: 召唤一头幽虎同伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽虎都会给你提供增益效果，可以增加暴击几率，并提升攻击和施法速度。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头幽虎的生命和持续时间。

English: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个为你提供额外生命回复和防御的巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的冲击波来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个巨石魔像，你受到敌人击中物理伤害的一定比例由其生命承担。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.
简体中文: 召唤一个嘲讽装置，嘲讽周围的敌人。

English: Summons a Totem which uses this Skill
简体中文: 召唤一个使用该技能的图腾

English: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
简体中文: 召唤一个发射分叉箭矢的弩炮图腾。

English: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个发射穿刺箭矢的弩炮图腾。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，消耗钢刃碎片以发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】提供。

English: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射多支箭矢，每支以一个敌人为目标。箭矢落地时对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢以一条直线击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢沿两条垂直线条击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a horde of Hiveborn Breach monsters to do your bidding. These summoned monsters have all their physical damage converted to cold.
简体中文: 召唤一支裂隙虫群怪物大军为你作战。这些被召唤的怪物会将其全部物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。

English: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
简体中文: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会被动地跟随你，不会攻击敌人。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。不能被触发或受“施法回响”和“释出”辅助，不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用。

English: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会施放凌厉的区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，偶尔还会消耗它们来强化自己，并给自己回血。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。

English: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 在目标地点周围召唤一圈弩炮图腾。这些弩炮会向目标地点射击一次后消失。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
简体中文: 召唤只能存在极短时间的愤怒狂灵，这些火焰魔侍将会冲至敌人身边并快速的进行攻击，并将其造成的所有物理伤害转化为火焰伤害。敌方生物将不会主动攻击这些狂灵，并可以穿越它们。

English: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
简体中文: 召唤一头幽狼伙伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽狼都会给你提供增加攻击伤害的增益效果。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头的生命和持续时间。

English: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会吞噬附近的灵柩并为你回复生命.

English: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会与你和你所操控的所有图腾之间产生火焰连接, 经过火焰连接或是靠近火焰连接尾端的敌人将会受到燃烧伤害.

English: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，向你和你操控的其他图腾发射一道火焰光束，使被光束击中的敌人受到燃烧伤害。光束两端附近的敌人也会受到燃烧伤害。达到最大激活图腾数量时，该技能召唤的所有图腾将引爆，并在一段时间内对敌人施加相同的燃烧伤害。

English: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续对附近的敌人喷射火焰，并在图腾周围创造一片奉献地面。

English: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。

English: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。受光环影响的对象被击中时，图腾会损失生命来承担部分伤害。

English: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会持续的震动附近的地面, 击退附近的敌人并造成伤害.

English: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续震动附近的地面，对敌人造成伤害。

English: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续的嘲讽周围的敌人对其进行攻击.

English: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像，启动时会提高你的暴击和命中。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。

English: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。

English: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。它会在低血时触发一个自毁法术，造成范围伤害并发射环形的冰霜投射物。

English: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.
简体中文: 召唤一支由强大的魔侍将军所统率，由魔侍兵，魔侍弓箭手与魔侍法师所组成的魔侍大军。

English: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.
简体中文: 召唤一个德瑞的雕像，该雕像会在一个范围内投射插在德瑞之肤上的所有诅咒技能。这些诅咒的效能较弱。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.
简体中文: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放两个下列增益法术：秘术增强，加快施法速度并提高魔力再生率，以及一个有几率导致感电并穿透闪电抗性的增益效果。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 1 个额外投射物，连锁 +1，投射物穿透 1 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 2 个额外投射物，额外连锁 2 次，投射物穿透 2 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的冰雷先驱者. 先驱者偶尔会冰缓或感电敌人并连锁到附近的敌人.

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对敌人施加提高效果的冰缓或感电效果，并连锁给周围其它敌人。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.
简体中文: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放秘术增强，提高施法速度和魔力再生率。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有队友的行动速度。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有敌我单位的行动速度。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，并降低你受到的伤害。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，降低你受到的伤害。并使被你击败的敌人爆炸，造成其生命上限 10% 的物理伤害。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的不屈先驱者。在你持续吟唱时, 先驱者偶尔会对你施放一个增益, 减少你受到的伤害, 使你免疫所有晕眩和元素异常状态。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会在你持续吟唱时偶尔会对你施放一个增益效果，减少你受到的伤害，使你避免所有晕眩和元素异常状态，并免受诅咒影响。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Arohongui tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes travel skills recover cooldowns faster. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的亚欧红古部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，提升旅行技能的冷却回复速度。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Hinekora tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates mana. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的辛格拉部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你获得魔力再生。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Kitava tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes a percentage of your leech recover instantly. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的奇塔弗部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使一定比例的生命偷取立即生效。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ngamahu tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which allows totems to take some damage from hits for you. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的努葛玛呼部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，让图腾替你承受部分击中伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ramako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents additional damage from suppressed spells. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的雷默科部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，压制法术时能阻挡更多伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Rongokurai tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which lets a percentage of your armour protect against all damage types. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

简体中文: 辅助瓦尔法术技能，使其在施放时重复，但代价是消耗你的生命与能量护盾。无法辅助图腾技能、持续吟唱技能、触发类技能、瞬发技能、反击技能、闪现技能或带有保留效果的技能。

English: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on critical strike. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助法杖攻击，使其在暴击时有一定几率触发念动紊流。无法辅助触发技能或非你本人使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on kill. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助法杖攻击，使其在击败时有几率触发念动紊流。无法辅助触发类技能或非你本人使用的技能。无法影响召唤物的技能。

English: Supports Warcries that are not triggered. Supported Warcries create Consecrated Ground, but have lowered area of effect and cooldown recovery.
简体中文: 辅助非触发的战吼技能。被辅助的战吼将生成奉献地面，但会降低效果范围与冷却回复速度。

English: Supports any bow or wand attack skill, causing it to summon a ballista totem that uses the skill for you.
简体中文: 辅助任意弓类或法杖技能，改为召唤一个弩炮图腾，替你施放该技能。

English: Supports any channelling skill, protecting you from damage while you channel it. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助任何吟唱技能，在你持续吟唱时保护你。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.
简体中文: 辅助具有保留效果的非祝福技能。

English: Supports any non-blessing skill. Minions cannot gain the Lifetap buff.
简体中文: 辅助任意非祝福技能。召唤生物不能获得赤炼效果。
辅助所有技能宝石。

English: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.
简体中文: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，对被辅助技能施加消耗和保留加成。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。

English: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.
简体中文: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，提升被辅助技能的等级。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。

English: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.
简体中文: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，提升被辅助技能的品质。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。

English: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.
简体中文: 辅助可使敌人冰缓或产生冰缓区域的技能。

English: Supports any skill that can kill enemies.
简体中文: 辅助任意能击败敌人的技能。

English: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意能造成伤害或有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill that deals damage.
简体中文: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能。

English: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间或能通过击中造成异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill that has a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments
简体中文: 辅助任意可以击中敌人或施加异常状态的技能

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取能量护盾。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech life based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取生命。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making it easier to stun enemies with those skills.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使被辅助技能更容易眩晕敌人。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的冰霜抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的元素抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的火焰抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的闪电抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，或能直接造成燃烧伤害的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.
简体中文: 辅助任意能击中敌人或对敌人造成元素异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies.
简体中文: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，如果敌人在被击中后低于 10% 生命上限值则会被立即击败。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.
简体中文: 辅助任何能击中敌人的技能。若普通或魔法怪物被这些技能击中后，其剩余生命值低于一定百分比，则会被直接斩杀。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能。召唤生物无法获得凌厉。

English: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.
简体中文: 辅助能击中或燃烧敌人的技能，以及能施加元素异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill with a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.
简体中文: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，不论该技能是否造成伤害。

English: Supports any skill with an area of effect.
简体中文: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能。

English: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助任意你用来击中敌人的技能。无法辅助图腾，陷阱和地雷所施放的技能。

English: Supports any skill. Minions, Totems, Traps and Mines cannot gain Inspiration Charges.
简体中文: 辅助任意技能。召唤生物、图腾、陷阱、地雷无法获得启迪球。

English: Supports attack skills that aren't triggered.
简体中文: 辅助并非被触发施放的攻击技能。

English: Supports attack skills that can be used with Wands. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助法杖可以使用的攻击技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attack skills that can be used with bows. Supported skills can only be used with bows. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助弓类可以使用的攻击技能。被辅助的技能只能用弓才能生效。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attack skills that fire projectiles, making the increase to physical melee damage from strength also increase their physical projectile damage.
简体中文: 辅助发射投射物的攻击技能，使力量属性也会像提高近战物理伤害一样提高投射物物理伤害。

English: Supports attack skills that hit enemies, causing those hits to leech mana based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助击中敌人的攻击技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取魔力。

English: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.
简体中文: 辅助使用弓类或法杖发射投射物的攻击技能。你不再使用被辅助的技能，而是投掷地雷。引爆地雷时，地雷会对你所在的位置使用该技能。地雷无法使用吟唱技能。

English: Supports attack skills, or other skills that can maim enemies.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能，或其它能使敌人瘫痪的技能。

English: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.
简体中文: 辅助能造成伤害的攻击或法术技能。

English: Supports attack skills, providing a bonus to all damage dealt by those skills while your life is full.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能，当你满血时该技能造成的所有伤害提高。
辅助攻击技能。

English: Supports attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助触发技能、召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attacks, causing them to trigger the Prismatic Burst spell. Cannot support triggered attacks or attacks used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助攻击，使其触发棱光魔爆法术。不能辅助触发攻击技能或除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助影响你和友军的光环技能，提高光环对友军的效果，但使其无法作用于你。无法辅助诅咒类光环，或其他只影响敌人的光环。无法辅助图腾所施放的技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。

English: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.
简体中文: 辅助在你周围产生永久性效果的光环技能，将它们的保留效果变为具有消耗的暂时性效果，不能辅助旗帜技能和姿态技能。

English: Supports aura skills that reserve life or mana to create auras around you.
简体中文: 辅助保留生命或魔力并在你周围产生光环的技能。

English: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助旗帜技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.
简体中文: 辅助将箭矢像投射物一般向前发射的弓箭攻击技能。被辅助技能改为朝空中射出一支负载箭矢，落到目标地点。然后向外射出一圈箭矢。不能辅助原本就朝空中射击的技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。

English: Supports bow attack skills, causing them to trigger when you've spent enough mana in total on other bow attacks. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Cannot support totems, traps, mines, Vaal skills, or channelling skills
简体中文: 辅助弓箭攻击技能，当你在其他弓箭攻击上花费足够魔力时触发它们。无法影响召唤生物的技能。不能辅助图腾、陷阱、地雷、瓦尔技能或吟唱技能

English: Supports bow attack skills. Cannot support channelled skills, instant skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助弓类攻击技能。无法辅助引导技能、瞬发技能、瓦尔技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports brand skills that can be recalled.
简体中文: 辅助可被召回的烙印技能。

English: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助你自己施放的持续吟唱法术，随着施法时间的提高大幅增强被辅助技能的伤害与消耗。无法修改召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports hex curse skills, causing them to trigger Doom Blast when the hex ends. Cannot support curse skills which are triggered or applied as an aura.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，使魔蛊在结束时触发【末日爆炸】。不能辅助触发型和光环类诅咒技能。

English: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，将其变为光环，并将它的效果施加给你周围的所有敌人。
辅助魔蛊诅咒技能。

English: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，光环或诅咒区域的魔蛊无法被转移。
辅助羁绊技能。
辅助印记诅咒技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills that are not triggered.
简体中文: 辅助并非被触发施放的近战攻击技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills which can be exerted. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Vaal skills and channelling skills cannot be exerted.
简体中文: 辅助可以被增助的近战攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。瓦尔技能和持续吟唱技能无法被增助。

English: Supports melee attack skills without a cooldown. Those skills will be used by Mirage Warriors summoned by General's Cry. Supported skills cannot be supported by Multistrike.
简体中文: 辅助没有冷却时间的近战攻击技能。这些技能由将军战吼召唤的幻影武士使用。被辅助技能无法被多重打击辅助。

English: Supports melee attack skills you use yourself. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助你亲自施放的近战攻击技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能对流血敌人造成更多伤害，但该技能无法再使敌人流血。

English: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复三次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat twice when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复两次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。
辅助近战攻击技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，无法辅助触发攻击技能、除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能，或能够召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Minions cannot gain rage.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能。召唤生物无法获得怒火。

English: Supports melee attacks you use yourself. Does not modify skills used by minions.
简体中文: 辅助你亲自使用的近战攻击。无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。

English: Supports melee attacks. Does not modify skills used by minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。

English: Supports melee strike or slam skills. Every third time you use a supported attack, that use of the skill will be more powerful.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能和猛击技能。被辅助技能每次施展第三次的时候都会施放强力一击.

English: Supports melee strike skills that do not inherently apply Trauma. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助本身不会施加内伤的近战打击技能。不能辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能或除你之外的生物使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，在每个击中的目标周围造成溅射伤害。

English: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，使该技能可以同时打击额外的目标，额外目标和使用者之间必须保持最小距离。如果用来辅助召唤生物的攻击技能，则该召唤生物不会获得额外打击目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能或触发技能。
辅助非光环魔蛊诅咒技能。
辅助非祝福法术。
辅助非瞬发法术技能。

English: Supports offering skills you use yourself.
简体中文: 辅助由你亲自施放的奉献技能。

English: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.
简体中文: 辅助使用弓类或法杖的投射物攻击技能。不能辅助触发技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。
辅助投射物攻击技能。

English: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.
简体中文: 辅助投射物和其他任意能连锁的技能。

English: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.
简体中文: 辅助投射物技能，使该技能的投射物在首次击中敌人时不再穿透并分叉成 2 个。

English: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.
简体中文: 辅助投射物技能，使它们的投射物在头两次击中敌人且未穿透时，分裂为两个。
辅助投射物技能。

English: Supports projectile spells you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助你自身施放的投射物法术。无法辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能、瞬发技能、持续吟唱技能，有保留效果或产生召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports ranged attack skills that fire projectiles upwards. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助向上发射投射物的远程攻击技能。无法辅助触发类攻击、非你亲自使用的攻击，或创造召唤生物的技能。
辅助反击技能。

English: Supports skills that can hit enemies, or create minions. When those skills or minions kill enemies, or hit rare or unique enemies they will have a chance to summon a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.
简体中文: 辅助可以击中敌人或召唤生物的技能。当该技能或召唤生物击败敌人，或击中稀有或传奇敌人时，有一定几率召唤一个幻灵，该生物可以使用穿刺投射物法术造成物理伤害。

English: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助可创造可被伤害的召唤生物的技能。无法辅助触发类技能。
辅助召唤生物技能。

English: Supports skills that create sentinel minions, causing those minions to be created with a beneficial templar aura.
